definitions.explanation: The joint in the middle of the leg.
The upper part of the legs when sitting, where someone might sit or place things.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げて→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{膝|ひざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せました→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I put the child on my lap.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦{歩|ある}けません→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: My knees hurt and I can't walk.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばして→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{走|はし}ったら→走る：00519_hashiru⟧{膝|ひざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My knees started hurting after I ran.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{膝|ひざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother has bad knees, so climbing stairs is difficult for her.
The cat came onto my lap.
I placed the book on my lap and read it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{膝|ひざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抱|だ}いて→抱く：02131_daku⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm holding the baby on my lap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膝|ひざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦いました→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: On the train, the tired child was sleeping on their mother's lap.

notes: {膝|ひざ} means both 'knee' and 'lap.' The expression {膝|ひざ}を{付|つ}く means 'to kneel.' {膝|ひざ}{枕|まくら} (hizamakura) is when someone rests their head on another person's lap. Knee problems ({膝|ひざ}が{悪|わる}い) are common topics in conversation, especially among older people.
